tools.name: search-products
tools.description:
Search the Skybridge winter-sports catalog: skis, goggles, and cold-weather apparel. Handles any query: a specific product, a category, a gift, or open browsing. Never assume something is unavailable — always search before responding.

The response is data only: matching products (title, ID, "from"

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search-products" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the Skybridge winter-sports catalog: skis, goggles, and cold-weather apparel. Handles any query: a specific product, a category, a gift, or open browsing…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search-products" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
